variant: B: Sessions, sets, and one-repetition maximum

domain_invariants.requirement: All resource ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive path resource ids are 404, while non-positive body and query references are 422.
Exercises have unique code and active flag
Sessions belong to one user with UTC started_at and COMPLETED or OPEN state
Performed sets reference session and exercise with reps 1..100 and load_kg 0..500
One RM uses Epley load_kg times one plus reps over 30 only for reps 1..20
Completed sessions cannot change or add sets; voided sets are retained history
Users access only their sessions; admins may inspect all
All lists use ascending immutable id pagination with limit 1..100 default 20 and after_id greater than zero, returning nullable next_after_id.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin; GET /health is public and all private routes require valid local Bearer authentication with deny-by-default.
Writes require application/json; malformed JSON is 400, unsupported media type 415, and declared-field violations 422.
The specification is local and deterministic without network, filesystem, upload, or external dependency; 500 and 503 leave state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no authorization, accepting no input; it shall validate local persistence availability, make no persistent change, and emit only 200 or 503.
